text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Dia-san, have you ever heard of the 
birthday crisis?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, all those various ailments that 
happen right around your birthday, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it is true that I have been 
feeling somewhat out of shape lately.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is what you'd call a jinx, and 
I'm currently thinking of how to break it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. I had a feeling. So for 
Dia-san, here'sâ

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm giving you one of my personal rules as 
a present!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Right, as long as I have my own rules, I 
can stay positive. I won't let any jinx 
beat me!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this birthday 120 miles of pure 
happiness!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Gran-san... Fufu, if you say so, then 
there's no doubt about it. I'll gladly 
accept it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So, what kind of 'personal rule' is this 
that you are gifting to me?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Let's watch idol videos for your 
birthday!" That's the plan! Come on, let's 
watch together right now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a wonderful personal rule. With 
this, you're sure to overcome any jinx!
